name: resume-creator-plugin
description: Create tailored mechanical or DevOps/Cloud resumes for Rajendra and Vikram from job descriptions and render HTML or PDF outputs.

interface.shortDescription: Tailor mech or DevOps/Cloud resumes for Rajendra or Vikram and export recruiter-ready output.
interface.longDescription: Use the packaged resume workflow to choose Rajendra or Vikram, choose a domain such as mech or devops-cloud, apply a tailoring level, generate updated HTML output, and export the PDF artifact.
defaultPrompt: Create an Aggressive devops-cloud resume for Rajendra using this JD.
Create a Tailored mech resume for Vikram for this role.
Generate HTML and PDF output for this domain-specific resume request.
